heapOrArchives.title: ACME Savings and Loan
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Rezzing ACME S&L costs 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. When you rez ACME S&L, gain [12] and trash ACME S&L. For the remainder of the game, pay [1] at the end of each of your turns, or lose the game. You can remove this effect, and score 1 agenda point, by taking an action to pay [12].

ice.title: Vacuum Link
ice.rulesText: [Subroutine] Roll a die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Runner resumes the run from that many pieces of rezzed ice back, or jacks out. If there are not that many pieces of ice, Runner returns to the first piece of ice.

root.title: Department of Truth Enhancement
root.rulesText: A: Put [3] from the bank on Department of Truth Enhancement. A: Take all the bits from Department of Truth Enhancement.

removedFromGame.title: MIT West Tier
removedFromGame.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.
